body: The reviewed package has no submitted jobs. When authorized, validate and execute planned_preparation.txt, record its parent job and full Iris workspace-bundle URI, and retain the completed cache audit. Then release the eight-run calibration stage against its exact plan and audit hashes. Keep the frozen workspace for subsequent stages; collect historical results directly from saved plans. See .agents/projects/starcoder_tpp10/README.md and validation.json.
title: Release bounded preparation after completed offline review
